trajectory_policy: fit0..3 follow constant action index, sharing schedule0; all remaining trajectories use independent fixed pseudorandom action sequences; audit actions never depend on predicted audit returns
microbatch_schedule: seed*100003 + 600000 + schedule_id*1009 + microstep; schedule_id=0 for fit0..3 else trajectory; teacher/noise seed107+microstep
branch_control: Each four-action set clones identical local parameters AND complete SGD momentum; branches share future minibatches and stochastic marks. Every branch actually executes all8 gradient steps, including zero action which preserves state. Field probes are measured at the declared block boundaries.
richer: field plus adapt digit CE, clean image/text/digit losses, all8 module displacements, text logit margin mean/p10, image-observer probability margin mean/p10, low text/image margin fractions
generic: fixed seed271028 QR seven-dimensional projection of same standardized richer measurements
fit_family: 20 fixed candidates: linear/full-quadratic ridge lambda .01,.1,1,10; RBF widths .5,1,2 with lambda .001,.01,.1,1. Eight leave-one-complete-trajectory-out folds with fold-only normalization. Select smallest CV delta-value MSE; listed-order tie break. Full fit uses fit trajectories only.
prediction: four post-block values; zero action exactly current value, delta bounded[-2,2], final value bounded[-1.004,.998], standardized coordinates clipped[-10,10]. No two-step MPC or exact Bellman/FBSDE claim.
audit_freeze: Commit all fit records digest, complete predictor JSON hashes, exact source and planned decision_steps before audit trajectories. Append each audit prediction before evaluating any branch outcome at its snapshot.
scoring_population: The same fixed training response panel across fit/audit trajectories. Audit tests new optimizer paths, not new task labels or new writers.
governance: No audit predictor refit/selection; no new test/retention outcome access unless all prior pilot and trajectory gates pass. A failed audit is preserved and any revision needs separately registered development and fresh trajectory identifiers.
gates: Use the immutable numeric gates in PILOT_PROTOCOL.json and independent field_bridge_v2_20261027_review/gate_audit.py, with complete trajectory rather than row uncertainty.
cost: Record every branch, gradient example, teacher/probe/value forward and wall time. Full-bank search is shared cost and cannot be omitted from field adaptation cost.
evidence: Keep per-example hard-value arrays, complete output hash aggregates, before/after model+optimizer hashes, schedules, chosen trajectory terminal checkpoints and predictions-before-outcome records. Bank labels are tensor-equivalent uint8/UTF8 development scores, not a fresh delivered deployment evaluation; real PNG/UTF8 scoring equivalence is separately tested.
